Functions.//QueuePrefix: Redis namespace for the function queues. Empty (the default) keeps the key names this protocol has always used. Set it only where more than one environment shares a Redis, and set RUNNER__QueuePrefix to the same value on every runner that serves this control plane — a mismatch is silent, the runner simply never receives work.
Functions.//Registry: The registry builds are pushed to and runs are pulled from. It MUST be the same registry every runner on this control plane can reach: a host-local address (127.0.0.1:5000) only works when exactly one runner consumes the queues, otherwise a run claimed by another host cannot pull an image this one built. Keep in step with RUNNER__Registry on each runner.
